content:
The average distance from Earth to the Sun is approximately **93 million miles** (150 million kilometers).

This distance is also known as **1 Astronomical Unit (AU)**, which is used as a standard measurement for distances within our solar system.

The actual distance varies slightly throughout the year because Earth's orbit is elliptical:
- **Closest (perihelion)**: ~91.4 million miles (147.1 million km) - occurs in early January
- **Farthest (aphelion)**: ~94.5 million miles (152.1 million km) - occurs in early July
